seo.listingsDescription: Browse Japanese abandoned and unused school facilities by prefecture, city, facility type, structure, area, and floor count.
seo.aboutTitle: About みんなの廃校 and mextdir
seo.aboutDescription: mextdir is an information directory built around MEXT's みんなの廃校 listings, helping people explore abandoned and unused school facilities for their next use.

An empty school is
not an empty space.
home.manifestoText: Classrooms, yards, corridors. They still hold local memory and room for what comes next. mextdir connects the people who own schools with the people who need a place.

about.title:
Edit the future
of schools together.
about.body: mextdir is a place for connecting unused Japanese schools with new owners and new uses. Buy, lease, open. We are looking for people who can carry a building's time forward and make the next local landscape.
about.stepOneText: Find a school by region, area, or structure.
about.stepTwoText: Review the photos and facts. Imagine what the place can become.
about.stepThreeText: Contact the lister about terms and a possible site visit.

footer.note: A directory for schools ready for a next chapter
